name: lightningcss
reason: build-time CSS tool, a direct dependency of vite@8.3.8 and of @tailwindcss/node. Installed and run unmodified, never copied into this repository and not shipped to the browser, so MPL-2.0 (file-level copyleft) puts no obligation on our code. Re-review on any version change.

name: lightningcss-linux-x64-gnu
reason: platform binary of lightningcss, same reason.

name: lightningcss-linux-x64-musl
reason: platform binary of lightningcss, same reason.

name: pako
reason: dependency of pdf-lib (devDependency, used only to generate the synthetic fixture PDF). Zlib is a permissive license; installed unmodified, not copied into this repository.
